editorialFeatures.title: Gazoo Racing Dynamics
editorialFeatures.lead: Precision-tuned suspension and responsive 2.0L Dual VVT-i petrol powertrain.
narrative: The 2019 Toyota Harrier GR Sport brings track-inspired engineering to an executive luxury crossover. Tuned by Toyota Gazoo Racing, it features reinforced underbody bracing and recalibrated shock absorbers.
Delivering smooth, confident power through a 7-speed sequential Super CVT-i gearbox, it balances exhilarating road presence with everyday fuel economy.
